useLiveSignalStream native re-implementation: the web hook consumes the {signals,cold,tables} firehose via useRealtimeEvents; the ported sseClient delivers one typed signal_change SignalEnvelope per field, so each envelope is treated as a single sample. The chart buffers/throttle (LIVE_THROTTLE_MS=500), 5-minute rolling-window trim (LIVE_WINDOW_MS), point counter, and per-signal min/max/avg/count stats are reproduced; the tail buffer (slice to tailMax), pause-awareness, clearTail, resetChart, and the 1Hz tailRate setInterval (cleared on disable/unmount — no open handles) are reproduced. connected mirrors subscribe success; when the host ships no EventSource (the parity bundle's default, incl. tests) the stream stays connected:false and the page's existing Disconnected badge is the explicit unavailable state (rule 7).

No DOM elements, react-i18next, react-router-dom, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, framer-motion, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives (Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View), @tanstack/react-query, the ported web-parity hooks/components (request, useTelemetry, usePinned, useVehicles, sseClient, EmptyState, AlertBanner, Skeleton, FadeIn, RangePicker, Accordion, BulkActionsToolbar, SignalStatsPanel), and the shared apps/native AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens. Field access stays snake_case (request()'s camelCaseKeys keeps the original keys); no mi/min/mph/kwh/kw/psi suffixes or unit conversions are introduced (the page formats already-typed signal values).
